purpose: Exploratory comparison of Git CLI message search with an in-process libgit2 Revwalk. This is not an official 20-round API acceptance benchmark.

method.libgit2: Revwalk with TOPOLOGICAL | TIME; pushes HEAD and local/remote refs; case-insensitive message substring; stops after 51 matches
method.orderCheck: Each libgit2 query sample returned the same first 51 OIDs as the Git CLI sample.

conclusion: The libgit2 Revwalk prototype preserved result order but was slower for both queries, so it was not adopted.
limitations: Five exploratory samples per case do not establish P95 or a stable performance distribution.
The Rust prototype was temporary and removed after the experiment.
